AYUSH SHARMA Senior Software Engineer — Go | Node.js | AWS | Microservices | Distributed Systems +91-7042070822 | sharma.ayush3103@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/ayush-sharma3103 | Noida, India

SUMMARY

Backend engineer with 6 years of experience building large-scale cloud services in Go and Node.js. I reach for Go when the problem needs high-throughput concurrency and Node.js when building event-driven APIs and real-time workloads. I have also worked with React on internal dashboards and partner-facing platforms. I ship clean, well-documented, and extensible code, use AI tooling like Claude daily to move faster, and take full ownership of whatever I build from design through production.

NOTABLE ACHIEVEMENTS

Built a forex remittance platform processing INR 50 Cr+ — integrated a third-party payments aggregator, implemented a 15- minute price-lock window using Redis TTL, and managed KYC and transaction documents on S3. Zero reconciliation failures in production.

Built a global event bus using EventBridge that all downstream services subscribe to, enabling a fully event-driven architecture with no point-to-point coupling between services.



Led a monolith-to-microservices migration using the Strangler Fig pattern across 3 business lines on Kubernetes. Each service is now independently deployable and observable, and deployment time came down by 35%.



Set up structured logging and CloudWatch alerting across services to improve observability and cut critical data retrieval latency by 50%.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages: Go (Golang), TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, Java Frontend: React.js, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS Go: Goroutines, Channels, Mutexes, sync.WaitGroup, Concurrency Patterns, Distributed Locking Node.js: Express.js, REST APIs, gRPC, GraphQL, Swagger/OpenAPI, Serverless, Event-Driven Cloud & Infra: AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge, API Gateway, Cognito, VPC) DevOps: Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform, CI/CD, Fault Tolerance Messaging: Apache Kafka, Event-Driven Architecture, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, Dead-Letter Queues Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch Architecture: Microservices, Distributed Systems, Strangler Fig, Low Level Design, OOP, High Availability, System Design AI & LLM: OpenAI API, Claude, LLM Integration, RAG, Vector Embeddings, pgvector, Document Chunking, Prompt Engineering Practices: Clean Code, Code Review, Unit/Integration/E2E Testing, Agile, RBAC, JWT

EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer Trajector | Gurgaon, India | May 2024 – Present

Built a multi-tenant messaging service using Node.js, AWS Lambda, MongoDB, and S3. It supports per-tenant data isolation across 3 business lines, with modular code designed to handle individual service failures gracefully.

Replaced a manual document handoff process with a fully asynchronous serverless pipeline using S3, Lambda, and EventBridge. Client query resolution time improved by 30%, manual follow-ups dropped by 40%, and the entire flow is documented with OpenAPI specs.

Built a global event bus using EventBridge that all downstream services subscribe to, enabling a fully event-driven architecture across 3 internal operations teams. Events are routed automatically with no point-to-point coupling between services.



Set up structured logging and CloudWatch alerting across services to improve observability and reduced critical data retrieval latency by 50%.



Led the migration of a legacy monolith to independently deployable Go and Node.js microservices on Kubernetes using the Strangler Fig pattern. The migration eliminated single points of failure, reduced deployment time by 35%, and the entire CI/CD pipeline was automated via GitHub Actions.

Built PoCs for AI-assisted development workflows using Claude and OpenAI APIs, including a RAG pipeline for document processing with chunking and vector embeddings stored in pgvector.

Senior Software Engineer Leverage Edu | Noida, India | September 2021 – May 2024

Architected a forex remittance platform end-to-end, integrating a third-party payments aggregator, implementing a 15- minute price-lock window using Redis TTL, collecting and storing KYC and transaction documents on S3, and designing RESTful APIs with full Swagger documentation. The platform processed INR 50 Cr+ with zero reconciliation failures in production.

Used Go goroutines and mutexes to handle concurrent writes safely, keeping data consistent under load and reducing reconciliation lag by 60%.

Built an Affiliate Partner Platform using Node.js, React.js, MySQL, and AWS for 50+ external partners. The async CSV ingestion pipeline included deduplication logic that eliminated all duplicate entries at ingestion time.

Designed a JWT and AWS Cognito auth service with Redis token blacklisting. It secures 10+ microservices across 3 user roles with consistent RBAC enforcement and is stateless and horizontally scalable.

Automated invoice generation using a threshold-based async pipeline with SNS notifications and reconciliation. This saved 8+ hours/week of manual finance work and required zero ongoing intervention.

Maintained 85%+ test coverage across unit, integration, and E2E test suites. Production incidents dropped by 40% after coverage stabilized, and we consistently reduced technical debt through structured code reviews and iterative refactoring.

Software Engineer Apric | Noida, India | December 2020 – July 2021

Built a cross-platform ledger app using Ionic and React.js with role-based dynamic UI for 3 user types, which reduced billing errors by 20%.

Developed Swagger-documented RESTful APIs in Node.js and MongoDB that served 2,000+ daily requests with consistent sub- second response times.

EDUCATION

B.Tech in Information Technology | Graduated: May 2021 Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (AKGEC), Ghaziabad, India
